parrafo_1.es: Morera Painting & Services es un negocio local que atiende Pembroke Pines y el sur de Florida. Sus clientes en Google destacan lo mismo una y otra vez: Adrian es honesto, meticuloso y entrega un acabado que supera lo esperado, ya sea una fachada completa o una remodelación de la casa entera.
parrafo_1.en: Morera Painting & Services is a local crew serving Pembroke Pines and South Florida. Clients on Google say the same thing again and again: Adrian is honest, meticulous and delivers a finish that exceeds expectations, whether it is a full exterior repaint or a whole-home renovation.

parrafo_2.es: Además de pintura, el equipo también se encarga de renovaciones completas: plomería, baños, pisos y carpintería, cuando el proyecto lo pide.
parrafo_2.en: Beyond painting, the crew also handles full renovations: plumbing, bathrooms, flooring and carpentry, when the project calls for it.

items.quote: We had a great experience with Morera Painting & Services. Adrian treated us with respect and was very honest. The quality of his work definitely exceeded our expectations. We are really happy with the results and highly recommend him.
Excellent work, immaculate attention to detail, great pricing, and most importantly, they take care of your home as if it was their own. I highly recommend them.

I just had the entire exterior surfaces of my house painted with Adrian from Morera Painting & Services. I am extremely satisfied with the job that he did. He is meticulous and takes pride in his work, which is rare to find nowadays.
